orientation.basis: The prominent title, body, lower label, and 2+ marker have level horizontal baselines and read left-to-right. The background display is oblique in scene perspective but does not require rotating the full image.

blindPixelObservations: Portrait frame filled with densely layered dark blue, black, magenta, red, and orange structures, including many looping cables and angular panel-like surfaces.
A large luminous rectangular display occupies the upper-middle area and is tilted slightly in perspective. Its face grades from cyan-blue at left to pink-red at right.
The display contains several rows and columns of very small white alphanumeric-looking marks. White starburst fractures and dark red splatter-like forms obscure portions of the display face.

Strong orange-white illumination enters from the right edge. Additional equipment-like forms, narrow label-like strips, and tiny character-like clusters occur around the left and right background margins.
A compact blue-white composite glyph followed by 2+ is centered above the main title plaque in the lower-middle area.

The lower region contains a wide near-black title plaque overlapping a larger translucent dark body panel. Thin bronze-orange outlines, stepped corners, projecting tabs, and mirrored diagonal accents define the frame.
The title is one centered uppercase line. The body is arranged as three centered mixed-case lines, with an orange uppercase line centered near the bottom.

The orange diagonal side accents are physically continuous with the panel frame. The display fractures, splatter, cables, and equipment retain irregular pictorial textures rather than isolated flat-symbol boundaries.
